large_validation_diagnostics.scientific_status: descriptive validation diagnostics; not a fidelity gate and not Geant4 validation

declared_diagnostic_gap.closes_when: A diagnostics pod replays epochs 79-114 from the retained checkpoints, or at minimum epoch 90, and the metrics are imported through scripts/refresh_continuation_outputs.py.
declared_diagnostic_gap.consequence: The accepted best checkpoint for this family, dicos-f-02 epoch 90, has NO measured distribution metrics. Its physics quality is unmeasured, not merely unreported.
declared_diagnostic_gap.reason: The RTX 3090 diagnostics pod ended between epoch 78 and 79 on 2026-08-12 and was not replaced before the campaign finished. The L40S kept training, so epochs 79-114 have validation loss, learning rate and structural-invariant evidence but no distribution metrics.
